title: Guest commentary: Artificial intelligence is inflating medical bills
hook_text: Your medical bills cost more now.
script:
Your next doctor visit might include algorithmic billing that drives up hospital revenue.
Hospitals now deploy automated software to parse patient records and optimize insurance claims.
These programs scan clinical notes to find extra billing opportunities and code more aggressive charges.
Patients end up paying higher out of pocket costs while navigating complex disputed statements.
Would you trust software to decide what your healthcare is worth?
